name: Tile Grid
description: The authoritative store for an isometric world: a fixed rectangle of tiles, each carrying a surface type and an integer elevation level. It is deliberately not a voxel volume. A voxel volume stores every cell in a column and can be hollowed out; a tile grid stores one height per column and cannot, which is the trade that lets an isometric world be drawn back to front by a painter instead of meshed.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application (generator/iso/IsoWorld.ts); not verifiable from this repository.
An isometric grid is drawn in 2D. The 3D runtime uses world.voxel_volume.

inputs.name: elevationLevels
inputs.description: Distinct integer heights a tile may take, 0 to elevationLevels-1. Isometric elevation is stepped, not continuous: a tile is on a level or it is not, and that is what lets one tile cleanly occlude another.
